editor.title: Address & look
editor.intro: How {{name}} looks to the world: a short address, and on top of the real public pages — a line, colours, doors and order. Every change goes to the members for approval.

address.title: The rikma’s address
address.desc: A short address that is easy to remember, say on the phone and print. Latin letters, digits and hyphens.
address.label: Address

status.pending: Another rikma has already proposed it and is waiting for approval
status.unknown: Could not check — try again in a moment
status.chars: Only Latin letters, digits and hyphens
status.edgeHyphen: No hyphen at the start or end
status.doubleHyphen: No two hyphens in a row
status.digitsOnly: Needs letters too, not only digits
status.reserved: This name is reserved for the platform
status.review: A name like this (bank, payment, a known brand…) needs approval from the 1lev1 team — write to us

focus.title: What do you do together?
focus.desc: Every rikma is a rikma — here you say what you do together. It decides which doors appear under the seal and the order of the sections. Colours, texts and images you already chose are kept.

hint.product: What we build, who builds it, how to join the build
hint.business: What we sell and how to reach us
hint.publicService: Who we help, what we have done, how to donate or volunteer
hint.community: The page as it is today: support and join
hint.creative: Art, content or knowledge — what we made and who makes it

profile.title: Under the seal
profile.desc: The round seal with the rikma’s picture and name always stays — it is what shows this is a rikma on 1lev1. Under it you can add a line and registration details.
profile.taglineHint: One sentence that says what you do.
profile.donationNote: Note next to the donate button

cta.title: The two doors
cta.desc: Under the seal there are two doors. Unchanged they are “Support the work” and “Become a part”. Here you choose where each one leads and what it says.
cta.label: What it says

style.title: Colours, type and corners
style.desc: Unchanged, the pages keep the platform’s gold and pink. A colour of your own replaces them on every page — the main one, join and support — and lightly tints the dark background.
style.goldOwn: Pick your own colour instead of gold
style.pinkOwn: Pick your own colour instead of pink
style.inkNote: The pages are dark, so where the colour is text we lighten it until it reads:

media.title: Background photo
media.coverHint: A wide photo shown dimmed behind the seal. At least 1600 pixels.
media.badType: Only PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF images can be uploaded.
media.failed: The upload failed, please try again.

stats.title: Numbers
stats.desc: Up to four numbers that show what you have done together.
stats.label: What it counts

partners.desc: Supporters, partners or clients — up to 12, with a link if there is one.
partners.name: Name

links.donateHint: If you have a donation page of your own, a “donate” door leads there. Without it — to the rikma’s support page.
links.accessibilityHint: A link to your accessibility statement.

blocks.title: Order of the sections
blocks.desc: What appears on the main page, and in what order. A section with nothing in it is not shown. Values and missions that follow each other sit side by side.

issues.primaryLinkMissing: The first door needs a link address.
issues.secondaryLinkMissing: The second door needs a link address.

preview.title: Preview
preview.note: These are the pages themselves, as someone outside the rikma sees them. Changes show at once, and you can click the doors to move between pages.

result.proposed: The proposal is open in the members’ hearts. If nobody responds by the end of the rikma’s response time, it is approved.
